title: Kissed Light Venezuelan Suet Soup
description: A cultured, creamy Venezuelan soup featuring suet and long-fermentation dough, served in a scallop shell for a light, lacto-vegetarian experience.
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 1 liter of water to a boil and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix the long-fermentation dough with 100ml water to rehydrate; let rest 10 minutes.
In a separate pan, melt 20g suet over medium heat until fragrant.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the suet, sauté until translucent.
Stir in the rehydrated dough, allowing it to dissolve and thicken the base.
Pour in 200ml plant milk and 50g plain yogurt, whisk until smooth.
Add chopped spinach, salt, and pepper; simmer until spinach wilts, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the hot soup into a scallop shell, garnish with a drizzle of olive oil, and serve immediately.
